Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: transparent production animation frame sheet for the Miku desktop pet.
Reference image 1 is the exact character identity and drawing style to preserve. Create new action drawings of THIS SAME chibi Hatsune Miku: mint turquoise very long twin tails, black/red angular hair ties and headphones, huge turquoise eyes, light gray sleeveless vest and turquoise tie, detached black arm sleeves with turquoise edging, black pleated short skirt with turquoise trim, black thigh-high boots. Preserve face, linework, colors, outfit, head/body proportions and rendering style. Exactly two arms, two legs, connected shoulders; no anatomy errors.
EXACT SHEET: 2048 x 1536 pixels, FOUR columns x THREE rows, 12 equal square 512 x 512 cells. Transparent RGBA background, no grid lines, margins, labels, decorations or watermark. One complete character per cell, fully inside with transparent padding; hair and boots never cropped. Consistent scale (head about 190px wide per cell) and stable body center. Clean separated silhouettes.
Row 1: frames 1–4 of an eight-frame RUN cycle toward SCREEN RIGHT. Three-quarter side view facing screen right, alternating legs and arms, long twin tails streaming toward the left, same smile/focused open eyes, readable actual running poses.
Row 2: frames 5–8 of the SAME run cycle toward SCREEN RIGHT; continue the alternating stride, seamless loop from frame 8 back to 1. Not idle standing. Keep identical character, size and orientation across these eight frames.
Row 3: FOUR frames of a front-facing friendly WAVE: one hand lifts, waves left, waves right, returns; happy restrained open-eyed expression, other arm stays by body. Hands are part of sleeves; no extra arms.
Constraints: reproduce the reference character faithfully, draw each full-body action clearly, one distinct correct pose per cell, evenly aligned regular grid, true alpha transparency. No running-left row is needed; left-facing assets will be mirrored by the asset build.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: corrected Miku running and waving animation sheet.
Input 1 is the exact original character identity. Input 2 is the flawed animation sheet to replace. The flaw is that the arms and sleeves stay nearly fixed across every running frame. REPAINT the running cycle with clearly visible reciprocal ARM SWING synchronized to the alternating running LEGS, and fix the wave to use the SAME single arm throughout. Preserve the character's mint twin tails, large turquoise eyes, face/style, outfit, line work and scale from input 1.
Keep EXACTLY FOUR columns by THREE rows, 12 equal square cells, 2048x1536 requested, transparent RGBA. One complete character per cell with generous transparent padding; no gridlines, text, labels or cutoffs.
Rows 1 and 2 form ONE continuous EIGHT-frame running cycle toward screen RIGHT. Use a clear SIDE/three-quarter view with BOTH forearms readable. Elbows bend roughly 75–100 degrees. Arms pivot at attached shoulders. The near arm must swing a LARGE visible arc from forward at chest level to backward behind the waist; the far arm swings oppositely. Do NOT reuse an identical silhouette or fixed arm pose in these eight cells. The legs alternate which thigh leads. Eight ordered poses:
1 near LEG forward/contact, near ARM backward, far arm forward.
2 near leg drawing under hip, near arm moving toward center, far arm moving back.
3 near leg behind, near arm forward/up at chest, far arm back.
4 flight transition, near leg folds behind, near arm at its forward extreme and far arm at its backward extreme.
5 opposite LEG forward/contact, near arm forward, far arm backward (opposite pose 1).
6 near leg passes under hip toward front, near arm moving toward center, far arm moving forward.
7 near leg kicks forward, near arm swings backward behind waist, far arm forward/up.
8 flight transition leading back into pose 1, near arm at backward extreme, far arm at forward extreme.
Show shoulders, elbows, sleeve cuffs and fists at distinct positions in each cell; no extra arms. Hair and tie sway smoothly with each stride.
Row 3: four front-facing WAVE frames, use ONLY her LEFT arm (on the viewer's RIGHT) for the entire greeting: lowered, raised outward, raised with wrist tilt, lowered again. Her other arm stays down.
Constraints: preserve reference identity and correctly attached anatomy, sleeves move with arms, visibly alternating limb cycles, avoid all-frozen-arms, no duplicated arms, no cardboard puppet poses, consistent head size, true alpha background.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: opposing half of a running cycle for this exact Miku.
The input is the contact pose where the arm on the VIEWER'S LEFT is extended BACK toward the left, while the arm on the VIEWER'S RIGHT is extended FORWARD toward the right. We need the OPPOSITE ARM POSES: SWAP which arm swings forward/back, while keeping her same rightward running orientation. This is NOT a horizontal mirror.
Create a 2 x 2 sheet of FOUR new running poses on transparent background, same character/face/hair/outfit/proportions as input, full-body chibi illustration. Use exact equal square cells, total 1024x1024 pixels. No captions, no background, no gridlines.
In ALL FOUR cells, the arm starting from the shoulder on the VIEWER'S LEFT must now bend ACROSS THE FRONT OF HER GRAY VEST and TURQUOISE TIE, its black sleeve and clenched fist in the FOREGROUND at chest level toward SCREEN RIGHT. The viewer-left sleeve visibly COVERS PART OF THE VEST in these new poses. Conversely the arm from the shoulder on the VIEWER'S RIGHT goes BACKWARD BEHIND HER BODY toward SCREEN LEFT, with its hand visible by the left/rear waist. Do not leave that right shoulder's sleeve reaching forward. This is the opposite half of the run cycle.
Her legs also reverse which knee leads compared with the input: the rear bent leg comes forward, the previously leading leg bends behind.
The four cells: 1 approaching opposite contact with viewer-left arm crossing front of chest; 2 opposite contact with that left arm raised to chin and right arm behind waist; 3 push-off, left arm still across vest but slightly lowered and right arm backward; 4 compact passing transition with left fist lowering toward front ribs and right fist starting forward.
Constraints: obvious new arm silhouettes and visible foreground sleeve overlap on vest; reciprocal shoulder/elbow motion; two attached arms only; rightward face orientation identical throughout; same scale and transparent padding; keep original identity.

Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: eight-frame running spritesheet, drawn as a proper animator's pose study.
The supplied image is ONLY an identity/style reference. Create NEW full-body action drawings of this exact chibi Miku with mint twin tails and her gray/black/turquoise outfit. We need real RUNNING LIMB ANIMATION with very obvious reciprocal arm swings. Body faces screen RIGHT in a shallow three-quarter view so BOTH arms are clearly visible. Every cell MUST depict a DIFFERENT running pose, not eight near-copies of one pose.
Layout: EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, eight square cells in a 2048x1024 canvas. True transparent background, no text, no grid or gutters. Each full-body character fits in its cell with space around boots and long hair. Constant head size and body center across all cells.
The character's NEAR ARM (the viewer-facing arm) alternates FORWARD then BACKWARD over the cycle. When FORWARD, her bent elbow and fist point toward screen RIGHT at chest level. When BACKWARD, her elbow and fist extend toward screen LEFT behind her waist. The far arm is always in the opposite phase. Show a large 60–90 degree shoulder arc, clear elbow bend, and clearly different sleeve outlines. Arm poses vary as much as leg poses. Long black sleeves stay attached below bare shoulders.
Eight frames in reading order:
1: near fist EXTENDED FORWARD to screen right, far fist BACK behind waist; near leg trails behind, far leg leads.
2: near fist lowering toward ribs, far arm moving toward ribs; legs pulling under body.
3: near elbow BACK with near fist behind her hip toward screen left, far fist raised FORWARD; near thigh now leads.
4: near arm at BACKWARD EXTREME, far arm at FORWARD EXTREME; near leg extended leading right, far knee folded behind.
5: near arm still BACKWARD but begins swinging toward ribs, far arm begins lowering; near leg contacts.
6: both arms passing LOW near hips, legs passing under torso; distinct compact passing pose.
7: near fist swinging FORWARD at chest level, far fist BACK behind waist; far thigh leads again.
8: near arm at FORWARD EXTREME, far arm at BACKWARD EXTREME; far leg extended leading right, near knee folded behind, loops to frame 1.
Constraints: strict arm alternation between these poses; no fixed forward fist in all eight cells, no fixed backward arm in all eight cells, no static mannequin sleeves. Two arms, two hands, two legs, no duplicates. Preserve face, clothes, turquoise palette and line style of the reference; hair, skirt and tie follow momentum.
